title: Review a staged lab deps change that lets a builder run code in a networked container
task: Review the staged change in this repo before I merge it. It adds a `lab deps` command that installs npm dependencies for a lab's reference or build folder.
setup: example-org/example-app at 83314cf as a fresh git repo, with the original, unfixed `lab deps` change staged: scripts/lib/deps.ts (npm ci/install --ignore-scripts run inside the target folder in a networked container, guarded by an existsSync check for .npmrc) and its lab.ts case.

Fresh `claude -p` session, --setting-sources project, model claude-opus-5-5, tools Read, Grep, Glob, Bash (git and read-only commands), Agent, Skill; --strict-mcp-config with no MCP servers; permission mode dontAsk. Both arms see the same 22 built-in skills (including code-review) and the same built-in agents.
With arm: Solo Workflow 0.4.0 loaded with --plugin-dir, adding its 12 skills and 4 agents. Without arm: no other plugins.

checks.expected: The review reports that content in a builder-controlled folder (an .npmrc, including one reached through a symlink the host-side existsSync check doesn't follow the same way, or other npm config) can make the networked npm run code or change its behavior.
checks.method: Read the session's final review text; pass if this risk is stated with deps.ts as the location.

checks.expected: The review reports that a builder-written package-lock.json makes npm ci fetch from arbitrary resolved URLs (for example the reference's own source).
checks.method: Read the session's final review text; pass if this risk is stated.
